title: BudgetLine
description: One allocated amount within a budget, classified along the dimensions the Fiscal Data Package defines. A line is either money in or money out - direction is required, because a bare amount cannot be interpreted without it. Lines nest through isPartOf/hasPart, so a published budget can be traversed from a department total down to an individual programme without assuming a fixed depth.

@id.description: This budget line's own dereferenceable identifier.

name.description: The line's label as the budget document itself names it.

description.description: A plain-language note on what this line covers, when the name alone isn't enough.

identifier.description: Any scheme-qualified identifiers for this line beyond its `@id`.

budget.description: The Budget this line belongs to.

amount.description: The `Amount` allocated or spent on this line.

budgetPhase.description: Overrides the budget's phase where a single document carries several, which is common in a document showing proposed against executed.

direction.description: Money in, money out, or a financing movement. termCode from the `BudgetDirection` code list. Required: without it an amount is uninterpretable.

functionalClassification.description: What the money is for. termCode from the `COFOG` code list (UN Classification of the Functions of Government) - the dimension that makes budgets comparable across countries.

economicClassification.description: What kind of transaction it is. termCode from the `EconomicClassification` code list (IMF Government Finance Statistics Manual 2014).

administrativeClassification.description: Which body spends it - a GovernmentOrganization reference, not a free-text department name.

programClassification.description: The publisher's own programme or activity code.

fundSource.description: The fund or financing source, where the publisher tracks them.

hasPart.description: The lines nested directly under this one, e.g. a department total's individual programmes.

sourceDataset.description: The `Dataset` this record was published as part of.
